notes: Same split as 10:10. The supplied *as for* was folded into the fronted nominal's unit; דְּמוּת פְּנֵיהֶם carries no object marker and no preposition, so no morpheme licenses the expression and it is its own `added` unit under rules 16 and 30, exactly as this chapter treated the supplied appositional *even* of 10:12. The construct's supplied *the* stays with דְּמוּת under rule 29.
